sourceBuildRepair.startup_line: neutral warm-white 0.50 mm core, 1.35 mm body, and 3.5 mm low-energy halo with static variation within glass
sourceBuildRepair.picture_field: continuous vertically expanding phosphor surface; no separately revealed bars
sourceBuildRepair.raster_dark_gap_floor: minimum modulation remains above 0.915 during stable picture
sourceBuildRepair.settling: deterministic <=0.35 percent geometry breath; no random or temporal noise
sourceBuildRepair.content: accepted typography/topology/schedules, curved to phosphor depth, reduced emission
sourceBuildRepair.late_suppression: desktop raster contrast 0.030 at frame 247 to 0.001 at frame 270; mobile uses the documented 0.72 multiplier
sourceBuildRepair.screen_spill: screen-only neutral-warm compensation; accepted lighting philosophy preserved
sourceBuildRepair.portal_cues: accepted geometry unchanged; transparent carriers until frame 220, original late strengths retained
